cases.name: Melanie Renee Willis
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Melanie was a patient care coordinator for Encompass Health in Prosper Texas. She loved traveling, drawing, painting, and crafting. She cherished her time with family and friends especially her nieces Kyleah, Avery, and Krislyn and her pets, Kit Kat, Harley, Cocoa, and Chunkin who she treated like family. She loved helping others, volunteering for pet rescue’s and helping at the animal shelters. She never turned away an animal in need."
